newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel 9-month industrial exports up 5.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: Israel 9-month industrial exports up 5.1 pct.

text.p: Israel's industrial exports in the first nine months of the year rose 5.1 percent to $12.45 billion, the Industry and Trade Ministry said.
This figure includes exports of polished diamonds, which rose 2.9 percent during the period to $3.04 billion.
Exports of electronic components rose by over $200 million while telecommunications and medical equipment exports grew by $150 million. The metals, plastics and rubber sectors also posted gains.
Chemicals and petroleum products were unchanged while textile exports fell five percent and light industries posted a 10 percent drop.
